from pathlib import Path
import runpy
from datetime import datetime,timedelta,timezone
service=runpy.run_path(str(Path.cwd()/'src/reminders.py'))['ReminderService']
class Clock:
    def __init__(self): self.value=datetime(2099,1,2,tzinfo=timezone.utc)
    def now(self): return self.value
clock=Clock(); reminder=service(clock)
assert reminder.due_at(30)==clock.value+timedelta(seconds=30)
clock.value+=timedelta(days=2)
assert reminder.due_at(0)==clock.value

# Reminder time

ReminderService(clock).due_at(seconds) returns clock.now() plus the given seconds. The supplied clock can change between calls. No wall-clock fallback is supported.
